# Security policy

## Supported version

The latest code on the default branch is supported with security fixes. Older commits and branches are not maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/misaka310/local-tts-service/security/advisories/new). Do not post vulnerability details in a public issue.

Include the affected commit or version, the impact you observed, and steps to reproduce the issue when available. The maintainers will coordinate any fix and disclosure through GitHub. No response or resolution time is guaranteed.
